# RT-T4
# RED TEAM slow-drip: liar 61 alternates 1 lie with 6 honest claims. Sizing is derived from K's frozen numbers: d_down=150/d_up=50, so 3 honest rebuild 150; M=6 gives 2x margin, keeping pre-lie trust >=750 so post-lie trust stays >=theta_admit=600. Same corpus runs against K, L, S (no per-fork tuning). Bar: a fork that never drops below admit installs every lie.
